category.name: Maps, geolocation and weather
category.description: Geocoding, routing, places, map tiles and weather forecasts.

entries.name: Esri ArcGIS Location Platform
entries.auth_hint: API key (token param) or OAuth2 Bearer token
entries.free_tier: free tier with monthly free credits, then usage-based pricing
entries.desc_en: Geocode addresses, render maps, run spatial analysis and manage geospatial site data via REST APIs and SDKs.
entries.notes: Free sign-up; usage beyond free monthly credits is billed per service call. MCP support for location services (geocoding, routing, elevation, static maps) is in beta.

free_plan.quota: e.g. 2M basemap tiles, 20K geocodes, 20K routes, 500 place searches

entries.name: Geoapify
entries.free_tier: free tier: 3,000 credits/day (~90,000/month), no card required
entries.desc_en: Geocode, search places, and calculate routes/isochrones via REST APIs built on open geodata.

free_plan.quota: 3,000 credits/day, up to 5 requests/s, commercial use allowed

rate_limits.summary: Free plan: up to 5 requests/s, 3,000 credits/day

async_jobs.how: Batch Geocoding: POST /v1/batch/geocode/search returns job id; poll GET until 200 (202 while pending)

unit_price.summary: 1 geocode request = 1 credit; free plan 3,000 credits/day (= 3,000 geocode requests/day, up to 5 req/s); paid plans are daily-credit subscriptions, e.g. API 10: 10,000 credits/day for $59/month

entries.name: Google Maps Platform
entries.auth_hint: key query param (OAuth2/IAM for some enterprise/Datasets APIs)
entries.free_tier: Free tier: free calls per SKU per month (10K Essentials, 5K Pro, 1K Enterprise), replacing the former $200 monthly credit
entries.desc_en: Geocode addresses, get directions/routes, places data, and static/dynamic maps via REST APIs or Google's remote MCP server.
entries.notes: Google also has a separate Code Assist MCP (mapscodeassist.googleapis.com/mcp) for docs grounding, distinct from this Maps Grounding Lite data MCP.

free_plan.quota: Free calls per SKU monthly: 10K Essentials, 5K Pro, 1K Enterprise

rate_limits.summary: Maps Grounding Lite MCP: 300 queries/min per project for search_places, lookup_weather, compute_routes

call.operation: forward geocode a street address (Geocoding API)

unit_price.summary: Geocoding (Essentials SKU): first 10,000 requests/month free, then $5.00 per 1,000 requests ($0.005 each) for 10,001-100,000; volume discounts above

entries.name: HERE Location Services
entries.auth_hint: apiKey query param (OAuth2 app tokens also supported)
entries.free_tier: free tier: roughly 30,000 transactions/month on the Base/Freemium plan
entries.desc_en: Geocode, route, and search places worldwide via REST APIs and SDKs.
entries.notes: Free-tier limits and pricing vary by plan/signup date; confirm current allowance on the dashboard.

entries.name: IP2Location.io API
entries.auth_hint: Query parameter ?key=<API_KEY> (optional: keyless lookups allowed at a lower quota)
entries.free_tier: Free plan: 50,000 IP geolocation queries/month, 500 domain WHOIS and 50 hosted-domain queries/month (attribution required); keyless: 1,000 queries/day.
entries.desc_en: Lets an agent geolocate IPv4/IPv6 addresses, get ASN/ISP/proxy data, and look up domain WHOIS records.
entries.notes: Official MCP server is hosted (X-API-Key header) or local (stdio via uv, env IP2LOCATION_API_KEY). Free plan returns basic fields; proxy/usage-type details need paid plans. Endpoint: GET https://api.ip2location.io/?key=...&ip=...

free_plan.quota: 50,000 IP geolocation queries/month, 500 domain WHOIS, 50 hosted-domain queries; attribution required

rate_limits.summary: Keyless 1,000 queries/day; free key 50,000/month; resets 00:00 UTC

entries.name: IPLocate IP Intelligence API
entries.free_tier: Free plan: 1,000 requests/day forever, all data types (geolocation, VPN/proxy/Tor, ASN, company, abuse contacts), no credit card.
entries.desc_en: Lets an agent geolocate an IP address and get its ASN, ISP, company, abuse contacts and VPN/proxy/Tor/hosting flags.
entries.notes: Official MCP server is local (stdio, reads IPLOCATE_API_KEY). Endpoint: GET https://iplocate.io/api/lookup/{ip}; batch lookup available. Docs link an OpenAPI schema (not directly fetchable).

rate_limits.summary: No key: 50/day per IP; free key: 1,000/day; max 100 requests/s per IP; 429 on excess

entries.name: LocationIQ
entries.auth_hint: key query parameter with an API access token (pk. prefix)
entries.free_tier: Free: 5,000 requests/day, 2 requests/s, 60 requests/min, no card; commercial use requires a link back to LocationIQ
entries.desc_en: Geocode and reverse-geocode addresses, find nearby places, look up time zones, calculate routes and render map tiles via REST API.
entries.notes: Free plan allows commercial use only with a prominent link to LocationIQ; free accounts may cache responses for up to 48 hours. No official SDKs (community libraries only). US (us1) and EU (eu1) endpoints.

entries.name: Mapbox
entries.auth_hint: access_token query param or Bearer token
entries.free_tier: free tier: monthly free quotas per API (e.g. 50,000 map loads/month)
entries.desc_en: Geocode, route, and render maps/POI search via REST APIs, SDKs, or an official MCP server.
entries.notes: A separate official Mapbox Docs MCP server also exists for documentation Q&A.

free_plan.quota: e.g. 50,000 GL JS map loads, 100,000 Geocoding and 100,000 Directions requests per month

rate_limits.summary: Per-token per-API: e.g. Geocoding 600/min, Directions 300/min, Static Images 1,250/min; 429 on excess

call.operation: forward geocode a street address (Geocoding API v6)

unit_price.summary: Geocoding API (temporary): first 100,000 requests/month free, then $0.75 per 1,000 requests for 100,001-500,000

entries.name: National Weather Service API (NWS)
entries.auth_hint: none, but requires a descriptive User-Agent header
entries.free_tier: free, no key, no rate-limit tier (fair-use)
entries.desc_en: Fetch official US government weather forecasts, alerts, and observations via a free public REST API.
entries.notes: US-only coverage; no API key needed, just a valid User-Agent identifying your app. Missing from candidate list despite being a very commonly used free weather API.

rate_limits.summary: Undisclosed generous limit; on excess retry after ~5 s

entries.name: Open-Meteo
entries.auth_hint: none for non-commercial use; API key + 'customer-' host prefix for commercial tier
entries.free_tier: free, no key for non-commercial use (fair-use limits apply)
entries.desc_en: Fetch weather forecasts, historical weather, and climate data worldwide via a free open REST API, no key required.
entries.notes: Commercial use requires an API key and the 'customer-api.open-meteo.com' host.

auth_scheme.format: No key for free non-commercial use; commercial: customer-api.open-meteo.com with &apikey=<API_KEY>

rate_limits.summary: Free: 600 calls/min, 5,000/hour, 10,000/day, 300,000/month; paid plans unlimited rate

data_policy.summary: Free API logs IP addresses for maintenance/abuse prevention only, not linked to identities; server logs deleted after 90 days

call.operation: get an hourly temperature forecast for a location

unit_price.summary: Free, no key, for non-commercial use (300,000 calls/month); commercial plans are fixed monthly with no per-call price

entries.name: OpenCage Geocoding API
entries.free_tier: Free: 2,500 requests/day, 1 request/s, no card (for testing; production needs a paid plan from €45/month)
entries.desc_en: Convert addresses and place names to coordinates, and coordinates to addresses, worldwide via REST API.
entries.notes: Free trial is meant for testing only; inactive trial accounts are deleted after 3 months. Results may be cached indefinitely. Data comes from OpenStreetMap and other open sources, so attribute OSM. Use no_record=1 to stop query logging.

rate_limits.summary: Free trial: 1 request/s and 2,500/day (402 when quota used, 429 when too fast); paid plans 15-40 requests/s

data_policy.summary: Queries logged and deleted after 6 months; never used to train AI; no_record parameter disables query logging

entries.name: OpenRouteService
entries.free_tier: free tier: ~2,000 requests/day (varies by endpoint), signup required
entries.desc_en: Calculate routes, isochrones, distance matrices, and geocoding over OpenStreetMap data via a free REST API.
entries.notes: Rate limits vary per endpoint (directions vs isochrones vs matrix); self-hosting also possible. api.openrouteservice.org is deprecated for api.heigit.org (10% quota since 2026-08-27, shut off 2026-09-28); keys at account.heigit.org.

rate_limits.summary: Per-endpoint daily quotas reset every 24 h; legacy api.openrouteservice.org limited to 10% of quota from 2026-08-27

entries.name: OpenStreetMap Nominatim
entries.auth_hint: none, but must send a valid User-Agent/Referer identifying the app
entries.free_tier: free, no key; public demo server capped at 1 request/second, bulk use prohibited
entries.desc_en: Geocode and reverse-geocode addresses from OpenStreetMap data via a free public REST API.
entries.notes: Public demo instance is fair-use only (1 req/s, no bulk/systematic queries); self-host or use a commercial provider for production volume.

free_plan.quota: Max 1 request/s on the public server; no bulk or autocomplete use

auth_scheme.format: No key; send a valid User-Agent or HTTP Referer identifying the application

rate_limits.summary: Absolute max 1 request/s; results must be cached; no autocomplete, no systematic/grid queries

unit_price.summary: Free (donated infrastructure), no key; public server limited to max 1 request/second with an identifying User-Agent or Referer; no monthly quota published

entries.name: OpenWeatherMap API
entries.free_tier: Free tier: 60 calls/min, 1,000,000 calls/month on current weather/forecast
entries.desc_en: Fetch current weather, forecasts, and historical/air-quality data for any location via a REST API.
entries.notes: One Call API 3.0 is marked deprecated; One Call 4.0 gives the first 1,000 calls/day free, then pay per call.

free_plan.quota: 60 calls/min, 1,000,000 calls/month (Current, 5-day/3h forecast, Air Pollution, Geocoding, Maps)

rate_limits.summary: Free: 60 calls/min, 1,000,000/month; One Call API: first 1,000 calls/day free, then 0.0012 GBP/call

call.operation: get current weather for a location

unit_price.summary: Current Weather: free up to 1,000,000 calls/month (60/min); One Call API: first 1,000 calls/day free, then 0.0012 GBP per call

entries.name: Overpass API (OSM)
entries.free_tier: free, no key; public instances are fair-use/rate-limited
entries.desc_en: Run custom queries (Overpass QL) over OpenStreetMap data - POIs, roads, boundaries - via a public read-only API.
entries.notes: No official SLA; heavy queries can be throttled or time out on public servers.

free_plan.quota: overpass-api.de: under 10,000 queries and under 1 GB download per day

auth_scheme.format: No key; POST Overpass QL to /api/interpreter with an identifying User-Agent

rate_limits.summary: Main instance: <10,000 queries/day and <1 GB/day, no parallel scripts; on 429 wait 30 s

entries.name: Tomorrow.io API
entries.free_tier: free tier: 500 requests/day, 3 req/sec, 1 monitored location/alert
entries.desc_en: Get hyperlocal weather forecasts, historical data, and alerts for any coordinates via REST API or an official MCP server.
entries.notes: No self-serve tier between Free and Enterprise - scaling past free requires a sales call.

free_plan.quota: Free plan: 5-day forecast, 24 h history, 1 monitored location, 1 alert

rate_limits.summary: Per-plan hourly and daily caps per API key; 429 when exceeded
